title: olearia rugosa subsp. allenderae
intro: Olearia rugosa subsp. allenderae, commonly known as Allender's tree daisy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to Australia. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Olearia rugosa subsp. allenderae are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, prevent cell damage, and modulate the immune system. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
